newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock chief's policy rift with Hopkins.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock chief's policy rift with Hopkins.

text.p: Newly appointed Ibstock Plc chief executive Philip Mengel said on Thursday that the board decision to give him "hands-on" control of the UK as well as the U.S. brick businesses forced the departure of Anthony Hopkins, the board member responsible for the Building Products division.

Mengel, who was appointed Ibstock chief last week, told Reuters on Thursday that "There were policy differences between us. The board gave me a hands-on-brief on both sides of the business and Hopkins felt his role wasn't enough."
Mengel has headed the U.S. Glen-Gery unit since 1990 and been on the board since 1993. Hopkins joined the company two months ago.
The chief executive refused to pinpoint any other source of disagreement with Hopkins, stating "it was nothing to do with specifics."

He said there would be no more changes to the top team, "I think we have an executive team which is very qualified now," he said. Mengel said the integration of the recently acquired Redland brick business was "our number one goal."
A spokesman for the company said Hopkins is currently in discussions about the financial details of his departure.
